property_summary: When an admin calls newEmergencyOracle with a description, the emitted NewEmergencyOracle event reports the caller as owner, and the resulting EmergencyOracle at that address has that exact description, is owned by the caller, and initially prevents external price reads because the oracle is turned off.
For any admin caller and any description, after newEmergencyOracle succeeds, the new EmergencyOracle is owned by the caller and is initially turned off, so getAssetPrice reverts.
For any description and any caller, calling newEmergencyOracle always reverts unless the caller is an admin, and admin status is never changed by the call.
